To fix this without changing the CUDA kernel, I'll change `ModelNew.__init__` to create the weight using an actual `nn.Conv2d` layer (matching the reference's init exactly) and copy its weight tensor, preserving dtype and shape.
</reasoning>

      "        ref_conv = nn.Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=3, bias=False, dtype=torch.bfloat16)",
